title: Northbeam product demo
text: Hi, I'm Alex from Northbeam. In the next minute I'll show you how Northbeam gets a new customer live without the usual back and forth. When a deal closes, your team opens a shared onboarding plan. Every task has one owner, one due date, and one place to ask questions. Your customer sees the same plan, so nobody chases status over email. The part teams like most is the handoff. Sales notes, the contract, and the kickoff recording move across automatically, so the customer never repeats themselves. Northbeam connects to Salesforce and HubSpot, and sends reminders through Slack. Most customers tell us the first week feels calmer, and their project managers run twice as many onboardings at once. If this looks useful, book a call with me and we'll walk through your current process together.

title: Pricing walkthrough
text: Let's talk about pricing, because I want this to be simple. Northbeam has two plans. Starter is forty nine dollars per seat per month, and it covers shared plans, reminders, and the Slack integration. Growth is eighty nine dollars per seat per month, and adds the Salesforce and HubSpot sync, single sign on, and custom templates. Both plans have a five seat minimum. If you pay annually you get two months free. There is a one time onboarding fee of two thousand dollars on Growth, and none on Starter. Typical setup takes about two weeks from signature to your first live customer. If your numbers look different, tell me and we'll work it out.

title: Anna at Acme, demo follow-up
text: Hi Anna, it's Alex. Thanks for your time today, and thanks for bringing Marcus from customer success. You told me your biggest problem is that new customers wait three weeks for a kickoff call, and that your team tracks everything in spreadsheets. Below this video I've put the pricing we talked about and the two questions Marcus asked about Salesforce. Have a look, share it with whoever needs to weigh in, and grab a time with me next week if it makes sense.

title: Security and SSO overview
text: A quick note for your security team. Northbeam is SOC 2 Type 2 certified, and we can share the report under NDA. Customer data is encrypted at rest and in transit, and it is stored in the European Union by default. Single sign on with Okta and Microsoft Entra is included on the Growth plan. We keep audit logs for twelve months. If your team has a questionnaire, send it over and we usually return it within three working days.
